decisions.statement: A color here is read from the color page of that color as a hex triplet.
A separator takes the plain grey the palette states.
A separator takes a color apart from every figure color.
The neutral every figure takes is lighter than the separator's grey.
The glyph a separator shows is a vertical bar.
Nothing here says which slot takes which color.
Nothing here reads a color the editor's own theme names.
Every figure on the status bar takes one and the same neutral.
That neutral is the design's second text color rather than its brightest.
A figure earning no color from a scale takes a neutral.

definition: the colors the status bar's figure slots take and the color and glyph a separator takes
